project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 7 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Shrawardine qualifies as a local detour through Shrawardine castle and settlement remains and REMAINS OF SHRAWARDINE CASTLE. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Shrawardine: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Shrawardine offers Shrawardine castle and settlement remains, REMAINS OF SHRAWARDINE CASTLE, CHURCH OF SAINT MARY within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Shrawardine castle and settlement remains
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Shrawardine castle and settlement remains and REMAINS OF SHRAWARDINE CASTLE, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
